title: Vampire Vape Koncept All Day Grape E-Liquid Short Fill 50ml
description: Fans of the fresh, juicy pop and deep, fruity sweetness of grape flavours are in for something truly special with Vampire Vape's All Day Grape from the Koncept collection. Bursting with rich purple grape flavour, with a sharp, intense inhale laced with a gentle menthol that softens the experience with a delightfully fresh and smooth finish, this could be the grape flavour you've been waiting for! At Vapestore, we proudly offer a wide range of Vampire Vape E-Liquids, including 50ml high VG Shortfills . With its unique flavour profile and satisfying vaping experience, it's no wonder why this e-juice has become a fan favourite. Trust Vapestore for all your vaping needs and discover the magic of Vampire Vape's Heisenberg today. Don't let your taste buds miss out. Order a bottle of this delicious Vampire Vape Koncept Heisenberg 50ml today, or sink your fangs into the equally delicious Vampire Vape Smooth Tobacco Koncept to immerse yourself in the ultimate vape experience. Every bottle Vampire Vape Koncept Shortfills collection contains 50ml of E-Liquid, with space for a 10ml Nicotine Shot to make it possible to tailor the e-juice’s nicotine content to allow discerning vapers like yourself to create a personalised nicotine level and vape experience to suit your vaping needs. These moreish 50ml Vampire Vape Koncept Shortfill E-Liquids contain a ratio of 70VG/30PG making them ideal for use with higher-powered vape kits and pod kits, as most of these devices will use a coil below 1.0ohm (Sub-Ohm) resistance. At lower resistances, coils are better equipped to handle the thicker VG ingredient of the E-Liquid, and produce satisfying, dense clouds with fantastic flavour.
